title: loadCases outer apiGet has no try/catch â€” loading spinner stuck on failure
detail: Lines 54-91: loadCases starts with `setLoading(true)` and directly awaits apiGet at line 64. Only the INNER progress query (line 73) has try/catch. If the outer cases query fails (401, 403, 500, network), the function throws and `setLoading(false)` at line 90 is never reached. The screen gets stuck on the skeleton banner at line 200 forever. No toast, no error banner. External testers will interpret this as 'onboarding broken' and give up.
evidence: Onboarding.jsx:54-91 loadCases function â€” outer fetch at line 64 has no try/catch wrapper.
recommendedFix: Wrap the entire loadCases body in try/catch/finally: `try { ...load...; } catch (err) { toast.show('err', 'Failed to load cases: ' + err.message); setCases([]); } finally { setLoading(false); }`.

title: Onboarding list destructures isManager but never uses it â€” +New Case visible to all users
detail: Line 44: `const { user, isManager } = usePortalUser();` â€” isManager destructured but not referenced. The `+ New Case` button (line 237) and the Delete/Restore buttons (lines 278-284) are rendered without any role guard. Same P2 as CR-0248/0255 but on the onboarding list. New Case creates a dcfg_onboarding_case with audit trail; Delete is soft-delete. External testers can create/delete onboarding cases.
recommendedFix: Wrap the New Case button in `{isManager() && ...}`. Same for the per-row Delete button. Keep Restore visible in showDeleted mode since it's a recovery action.

title: Progress query loads ALL checklist records across ALL cases (no $top, no case-id filter)
detail: Line 73-75: `apiGet('/dcfg_onboarding_checks?...$filter=dcfg_is_complete ne null')` â€” with no $top and no scope to the visible cases, this returns every checklist row ever created. For a system with 30 cases Ã— 30 steps each, that's 900 rows every poll, pulled in a single query. Power Pages Web API will cap at 5000 by default but the code doesn't handle that boundary. Cat 6 performance; also a Cat 8a candidate if dcfg_onboarding_check switches to explicit-fields mode in the future.
recommendedFix: Scope the progress query to just the cases currently in the cases list: build an `$filter=_dcfg_case_id_value in (id1,id2,...)` from the rows variable. Or switch to rolling-up dcfg_is_complete counts on the case record itself via a Power Automate flow and read them directly in the main cases query.

title: NewCasePanel declares error state that is never read or set
detail: Line 303: `const [error, setError] = useState(null);` â€” neither `error` nor `setError` is referenced anywhere else in NewCasePanel. Dead code.
recommendedFix: Remove the useState declaration for error.
